description:
Best Mid Drive Electric Bike Deal: Compare to electric bikes from Trek (Dual Sport), Specialized Cosmo or Giant Flat bar ebikes with disc brakes selling for around $2600+. The Elite eAdventure is the ideal combination of range capability, durability, speed and comfort at a fantastic price.

Global Service Network: Shimano has the largest global service network in the world. Make sure your next electric bike has Shimano STEPS electric motor system.

If you see a bike priced similar to Bikesdirect.com special sale pricing, make sure you are comparing apples to apples: • ROCKSHOX Suspension Forks • FULL SHIMANO Drivetrain • SHIMANO STEPS MID DRIVE MOTOR •Up to 100* MILE RANGE • 418WH SHIMANO Integrated Battery •SHIMANO Hydraulic Disc Brakes

We've shopped around and those other bikes are either: 1) Lower Tech / Heavy Hub Drive, or 2) NOT Best Performing SHIMANO MID DRIVE MOTORS 3) have lower spec parts such as housebrand wheelsets, housebrand tires/bar/stem/seatpost or 4) ALL of 1 and 2 and 3
